channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Man, 30, is jailed for ‘street-dealing’ heroin and cocaine in Colwyn Bay
item.description: A man from Liverpool has been jailed after he supplied class A drugs in the Colwyn Bay area.

item.title: Craig-y-don bar owner to open 'classy' new wine and cocktail bar in Llandudno
item.description: A new wine and cocktail bar is set to open in Llandudno, the second premises run by the owner of a bar in Craig-y-Don.

item.title: Minute's silence held at match following death of young Conwy footballer
item.description: A minute's silence was held before a football match following the death of a "much-loved" young footballer from Conwy.

item.title: St Kentigern Hospice announces decision to close Colwyn Bay store
item.description: St Kentigern Hospice has announced that its store in Colwyn Bay will close, a decision the charity said was "not an easy one".

item.title: Welsh trailer giant shifts gear for electric age - and creates new jobs
item.description: An iconic Welsh company is driving into the electric vehicle era with a new generation of lighter, stronger trailers.

item.title: Large police presence in Dolwyddelan sparks concern
item.description: Passers-by reported seeing a number of officers in Dolwyddelan on the evening of Tuesday, January 13, as well as what was believed to be a drone.

item.title: MS presses First Minister to confirm work on Rhyl hospital will start this year
item.description: "The electorate will see through this, and they know the plans for this hospital have been radically scaled down from the original specifications."

item.title: Plans unveiled for six flats on grassland in Old Colwyn
item.description: The site is described as a “vacant lot” situated “next to 20 Meiriadog Road” in Old Colwyn “east of the Old Colwyn Bowling Club and the adjoining allotment gardens”.

item.title: Long-lost grave of great-great grandmother found on Llandudno's Great Orme
item.description: After 20 years, cllr Dr Rob Atenstaedt has finally located the grave of his great-great grandmother on the Great Orme, thanks to a brief conversation.

item.title: Two arrested after discovery of large cannabis cultivation in Dolwyddelan
item.description: Passers-by reported seeing a number of officers in Dolwyddelan on the evening of January 13, as well as what was believed to be a police drone.
